code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia, with anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and neutropenia/lymphopenia, suggesting bone marrow suppression or severe infection. Elevated D-dimer, ferritin, INR, and mild CRP raise concern for systemic inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and multi-organ involvement. Renal function is mildly impaired. Findings are critical and suggest severe systemic illness (e.g., sepsis, severe viral infection, or hypoxic respiratory failure); urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
